### Cognitive Profile  
Your estimated CEFR level is A2+, meaning you can understand frequently used expressions and communicate simple needs. This reflects your ability to recall 111 mastered words (82% of those tested) and maintain 87% spelling accuracy—strong foundations for everyday conversations.

### Strengths & Growth Edges  
- **Listening Exposure**: Your perfect 100% score shows exceptional auditory engagement, with 403 audio plays reinforcing pronunciation.  
- **Memory Strength**: An 83% stability score (avg. 6.6/10) proves effective retention of learned words like "environment" or "community."  

- **Learning Consistency**: A low score (3/10) suggests irregular practice. *Try setting a daily 5-minute goal to reactivate your 26 due-for-review words.*  
- **Deep Engagement**: At 46%, you might rush exercises. *Pause to connect new words like "sustainable" to personal experiences—your 275 dwell minutes show potential for deeper processing.*  

### Your Learning Signature  
You’re building bridges—one word at a time—toward the UN’s vision of inclusive, lifelong learning. Keep crossing!
